resources.string: For example: 昨天晚上吃火锅128元，微信支付
Create an account first and enter its opening balance.
Check the amount, category and account. A payment method does not implicitly choose the funding account.
Review and save each entry separately.

Bookkeeping runs locally. Network access occurs only when you request configured AI suggestions or check updates. AI receives the current input and required catalog names; ledger history is never sent.
Phone and desktop maintain separate ledgers. Use a full backup to migrate. Save backups outside this app before uninstalling or clearing app data.
A previous confirmed operation needs reconciliation. Resume the original request to avoid a duplicate entry.
The local ledger is temporarily unavailable. Retry when ready. Unconfirmed input is never saved automatically.
Enter an amount at the account precision: JPY uses integers, CNY / USD two decimals, KWD three decimals.
Select a valid date, no later than today.
Check all required accounts, books, categories and time fields.
That name already exists. Choose another name.
This request previously saved different fields. Review a new request.
Resume the previous confirmed operation first.
The amount exceeds the supported range.
A full backup contains books, accounts, entries and images. Restore it on Windows or Android. AI secrets are excluded. Save a backup outside this app before uninstalling or clearing data.
After validation, the app switches to restored data in a new directory. The current ledger remains available through Switch data directory. Restoration does not merge ledgers.
File operation did not complete. Check the format, size and selected location.
Balances will be recalculated. Deleted entries can be found with Include deleted entries and restored. Related refunds must be handled before deleting an expense.
Transfers move money between accounts and preserve total assets. They are excluded from income and expenses.
A refund is linked to an expense and inherits its book and category. Partial refunds are allowed; combined refunds cannot exceed the original expense.
Archiving preserves history and asset totals. Archived items cannot be used for new entries.
When this payment method is parsed, suggest the selected account. The confirmation form still allows changes.
Changing the start date or opening balance recalculates the account balance. Existing valid entries cannot be excluded.
Enter the actual balance today. The difference and reason are recorded without changing income or expense totals.
Shares use expenses before refunds. Refunds reduce net expenses on their receipt date. Transfers, opening balances and adjustments are excluded.
The report could not be generated. For long images, narrow the date range or export a paginated PDF.

CSV and Excel support column mapping, validation and duplicate detection. Review before confirming selected entries. Maximum 10,000 rows and 20 MB per file. Exports contain all active entries; use backups for full migration.
Possible duplicate, not selected by default. Select only after confirming it is a separate entry.
This row has errors and cannot be imported. Correct the source or column mapping.
Save %1$d selected entries as one batch and update balances? Invalid rows are excluded. Possible duplicates require your explicit selection.
Revert the whole batch and its balance changes. Reversal is blocked if entries were edited, deleted or received additional refunds, preserving subsequent history.
The zone controls new entries and relative dates such as yesterday. Existing entries retain their dates and zones. Resume pending confirmations before changing it.
AI is enabled and runs only after you request AI suggestions.
AI is disabled. Local parsing works offline.
Pinning is unavailable on this launcher or system. Android 7.1 and later also support quick entry by holding the app icon.
Add Quick entry using the system Quick Settings edit screen. Every shortcut uses the same review and save workflow.
No AI service is selected by default. Configure OpenAI or a compatible HTTPS API. Secrets are encrypted using Android Keystore and excluded from ledgers, exports and backups.
API base URL, for example https://provider/v1
API secret (leave blank to retain the saved secret)
Delete the secret for this service
Remove the saved secret for this service. Other services and ledger data remain intact. Configure a new secret to use this service again.
Settings could not be saved. Reconfigure or retry later.
Send this input, date, time zone and catalog options to your configured AI service? Results require review before saving. Ledger history and balances are excluded.
Android version %1$s is available. View the GitHub Release and download manually. Back up your ledger before installation.
No usable Android release was found.
This APK is the latest available version.
No browser is available to open this link.
No reliable entry was identified. Add amount and date details or create an entry manually.
Choose an entry to review; save each separately
AI could not produce reliable suggestions. Check configuration and network access, or use local parsing and manual entry.
No usable secret is available. Configure the service secret again.
This record changed. Refresh and review again.
Related refunds or modified imported entries block this operation. Review related records first.
Backup validation or file operation did not complete. Original data remains intact. Check the backup and free space.
Import did not complete. Check mapping, invalid rows, duplicates or changes to the source file.
Unable to check updates. Retry later.
Removed images remain available for history recovery. Restoring an image does not change transaction amounts.
Cannot read this image. Choose PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 20 MB and 50 million pixels.
Accounts keep native amounts. Totals use your manual rates and never rewrite balances.
Add or edit a manual rate
CNY per one foreign currency unit
Quotation: one selected currency unit = the entered amount in CNY. Reports use the latest rate on or before each transaction; assets use the latest rate on or before today.
A rate already exists for this currency and date. Open that entry to edit it.
Some currencies lack a quotation. Add dated rates in Settings for complete totals.
For FX transfers enter both actual debit and credit amounts. Same-currency amounts must match. Record fees as a separate expense.
Notifications, OCR and speech create drafts. Balances change only after your confirmation.
Check the actual amount, date, kind, account and merchant. Recognition can be wrong; list prices and discounts are not separate expenses.
Choose the actual paid / received amount
This source event already exists. Opening the existing draft or record.
Off by default. Selected payment notifications become local pending drafts. Missing notifications, work-profile or restricted transactions need manual entry.
Notification access is unavailable. Grant access to this app in system settings.
Other package names, one per line (optional)
OCR failed. Select a clear PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 20 MB, or enter text manually.
No text recognized. Try a clearer original image or use text input.
No speech recognition service is available. Use text input.
On-device speech is unavailable. The system recognizer may send audio over the network. Continue?
Microphone permission denied. Enable it in app permissions or enter text.
Listening for one complete entry using the system speech service.
Listening for one complete entry using on-device speech.
Speech recognition did not complete (%1$d). Retry or use text.
Review the text before parsing. Example: 今天午饭花了三十五元，微信支付。
Create accounts with real opening balances, then bind payment channels. Review each recognized entry before saving. Read the manual and export full backups regularly.

Images and recognized text are processed on device. The bundled Google ML Kit SDK may send device, app and performance diagnostics to Google, excluding your images and OCR results. Cancel to use text instead.
Enter the actual destination amount for an FX transfer.
Currency mismatch; check the account and native amount.
This draft has already been processed. Refresh to view it.
